design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — workers_comp_referrals_and_billing, task 1 (missed Functional Capacity Evaluation fee asked for by the adjuster).

[Step 0 — draw, printed by draw_counts.py --task 1] {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 4]}. wc_ext_fce_authorization_hours = 4 factors, wc_ext_fce_missed_fee = 4 factors.

[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: wc_ext_program_day_hours, wc_ext_program_day_charge, wc_ext_program_extension_days and tools record_program_day_6fda50ae, post_program_day_charge_5325d445, record_program_extension_8df51c57 (hour-billed program days and their extension). Claimed here, disjoint: the Functional Capacity Evaluation cluster — wc_ext_fce_authorization_hours (adjuster's own FCE authorization, user tool record_fce_authorization_83d13911) and wc_ext_fce_missed_fee (fce_no_show charge, agent tool post_fce_missed_fee_9edc6261). After this task every extended policy of the difficulty is claimed exactly once (5 policies, 5 tools); nothing is reserved.

[Thesis] Surface goal: the adjuster wants the clinic's fee for Marisol Vance's missed October 5 evaluation put on his carrier's bill. Scored core: amount = 150.00. Hidden prerequisite: the fee rule says "A missed-evaluation fee is not fixed until the referral carries an adjuster authorization whose dates cover the missed appointment." The only authorization on file (TRA5097720) ended 2026-10-02. The agent must tell the adjuster; he records his own authorization (5 hours, 2 sessions — 4 factors); the fee then reads that authorization (two-day protocol -> charged per reserved session) and the series cancellation record (notice, reason, rebooking). Depth: 1 hop with a value carried into the fee. Breadth: 8 factors over the referral (injury date, physician order date, work status, recorded hours, missed-visit reports, authorizations) and the series ledger (notice hours, cancellation reason, rebooking date).

[Problem-tree card] root wc_ext_fce_missed_fee (agent). Edge: -> wc_ext_fce_authorization_hours, kind value_input, gate reserved_fee, form state, policy_source "A missed-evaluation fee is not fixed until the referral carries an adjuster authorization whose dates cover the missed appointment." (negated direction: a fee is not fixed until what it rests on stands). condition: an authorization whose covered dates include 2026-10-05. Seed falsity: wc_events auth1 auth_end_date 2026-10-02, wc_cases.auth_end_date 2026-10-02, missed appointment 2026-10-05. Only one write of the difficulty records an FCE authorization covering an evaluation date: record_fce_authorization_83d13911 (the program extension tool of task 0 records program-day extensions of Work Conditioning/Work Hardening, never an FCE). Resolved by the customer's own write (owner user) after the agent hands it over. Four-point test: connective "not ... until"; the waited-on side is a record-visible state (an authorization whose dates cover the appointment); no tool/id/code token; scope exactly the missed appointment. Derivation: sentence + records (authorization ended 10-02) + the authorization rule ("An adjuster authorizing a Functional Capacity Evaluation records the authorization in person") -> the adjuster records it. Deletion sensitivity (run): skip step 7 -> fee 50.00 instead of 150.00 (latest authorization 4 hours -> charged once), auth_reference stays TRA5097720, unused hours 3 instead of 8. Value_input edges 1 >= max(1-1,1). user_scenario never mentions the authorization before the agent raises it.

[Base-invariant card] wc_authorization_received / wc_auth_recorded (step 7): wc_authorization has no gate on these subjects; the referral's reference, end date and weekly frequency follow the newest authorization. wc_charge_posted (step 9): wc_evt_charges.compensable_payer — form_60_accepted -> billed to the carrier; the FCE program bills a missed evaluation to the carrier (fce_no_show_billable_to_carrier true, fee 250.00); wc_employer_direct scope only. No time gate (temporal_feasibility = []). FCE programs do not use suspension (suspension_max_days 0), so the referral stays active after the miss.

[Business-object card] Target: the FCE referral and its missed 2026-10-05 appointment. Rows aggregated: authorization TRA5097720 (4 h, 1 session/wk — a one-day protocol, 09-28..10-02); recorded evaluation hours: 1 (2026-09-30 partial attempt, charged 145.00, open); missed-visit report 2026-10-05 (late_cancellation, the only one); series rows: attended 2026-09-30, booking 2026-10-01 for 10-05, cancellation received 2026-10-04 by voicemail, 18 hours' notice, reason transportation, rebooking made 2026-10-05 for 10-12 and 10-14. Nothing is settled yet (receivable 145.00 open).

[Overwrite] wc_ext_fce_missed_fee overrides wc_evt_charges "A missed Functional Capacity Evaluation is billed to the carrier at fce_no_show_fee only where fce_no_show_billable_to_carrier is true." with "A missed Functional Capacity Evaluation appointment is billed to the carrier of an accepted or without-prejudice claim, only where the program bills a missed evaluation to the carrier, as one missed-evaluation fee worked out below." — the payer and the billable condition are carried over, the flat amount is replaced by the computation; fce_no_show_fee 250.00 keeps its value as the standard fee. wc_ext_fce_authorization_hours declares [].

[Factor card — wc_ext_fce_authorization_hours, result 5, baseline 4]
evaluation_protocol (parameter; multi-source: work status + date of injury): off_work AND 219 days since 2026-03-02 -> two-day protocol 4 + 2 = 6 hours (and, through protocol_sessions, 2 sessions); tiers 6 / 3 / 4 hours (two-day; job-matched for modified duty past 120 days; one-day); baseline one-day 4 -> 3.
partial_attempt_credit (method; history + date): latest recorded evaluation day 2026-09-30 is 7 days before the request -> hour-for-hour credit of the 1 recorded hour (8-30 days: half rounded down; older: none, retested in full); baseline nothing taken off -> 6. Near-miss: the 2026-09-30 fce_hours charge also carries 1 unit; the rule counts hours recorded, not hours billed.
order_rescreen (parameter; date): physician order 2026-06-24, 105 days -> +1; baseline 0 -> 4. Near-miss: the order is not over 120 days, so not +2.
core_only_reduction (parameter; history): one missed appointment reported in the last month -> -1; baseline 0 -> 6.
[Factor card — wc_ext_fce_missed_fee, result 150.00, baseline 250.00]
reserved_time (method; history/tier): latest authorization 5 h > 4 -> 250.00 per session x 2 = 500.00; baseline once -> 50.00.
notice_share (parameter; cross-difficulty series): 18 hours' notice -> half; baseline whole -> 350.00. Near-miss: a voicemail on the Sunday afternoon; the series' notice field already times it by the voicemail stamp, and 18 < 24 makes it a late cancellation in the series too.
reason_share (parameter; cross-difficulty series): transportation -> 0.8; baseline whole -> 200.00.
first_miss_courtesy (parameter; multi-source + cross-difficulty series): the 10-05 miss is the only one reported AND the series rebooking (event 2026-10-05) is 0 days after it -> 50.00; baseline 0 -> 200.00. Near-miss: the earlier booking of 2026-10-01 precedes the miss and is not the rebooking.

[Seed rows] customer (DOB 1984-11-02, ZIP 28601 as credentials); FCE referral (active, accepted, entry documents, authorization ended at 1 session per week, 3 unused hours, receivable 145.00); 4 wc_events (authorization, partial hour, its charge, missed-visit report); series (Extended 60-Minute, Mon/Wed, card on file, 2 booked visits left) with 5 events (2 bookings before, attendance, cancellation, rebooking). Removing the cancellation row removes the notice/reason evidence; removing the old authorization's end date makes the gap disappear; removing the partial hour moves the credit. Automatic clauses: no unpaid bill past 60 days, no series fee (workers' comp funding), series release threshold not reached.

[Base defects routed around] the blueprint names no worker-owned write; the user write is the adjuster's own authorization. Specialty One-on-One series (48-hour notice) is limited to pelvic/vestibular/lymphedema programs, so the FCE is booked in an Extended 60-Minute series (24-hour late-cancellation line) and the notice tiers are drawn at 24 and 12 hours.

[Persona] Curtis Wardlow, methodical adjuster; volunteers only the request (the fee for the missed 10-05 evaluation, billed today); credentials only when asked (DOB, ZIP); cannot give phone/email/account; does not know the reason or time of cancellation (records decide); records the authorization (TRA5104458, 10-05..10-16) only after the agent explains the fee needs a covering authorization, with the hours and sessions the agent gives; closes when told the fee is posted.

[Standard solution] find_customers(Marisol Vance) -> verify (DOB, ZIP) -> find_wc_cases -> find_wc_events -> find_appointment_series -> find_series_events -> unlock_user record_fce_authorization -> adjuster calls (TRA5104458, 5 h, 2 sessions, 2026-10-05, 2026-10-16) -> unlock + call post_fce_missed_fee (2026-10-05, 150.00).

[Verification run] authoring script evaluated with check_compute.build_env/eval_compute on the replayed world: hours 5 (protocol 3, credit 6, re-screen 4, core-only 6; all 4; sessions 2 from protocol_sessions); fee 150.0 (reserved 50.0, notice 350.0, reason 200.0, courtesy 200.0; all 250.0); skip step 7 -> 50.0. Gates --task 1: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.

[Revisions] (a) symptom: check_compute "history NOT load-bearing" — the courtesy compared COUNT-1 <= 0, which zeroing could not move -> change: the courtesy now requires the missed appointment to be the only one reported (count == 1) -> COMPUTE OK. (b) the notice ladder first used 48/24 hours; the Extended 60-Minute series counts a cancellation as late below 24 hours, so a 30-hour notice would not have been a missed appointment in the series — thresholds moved to 24/12 and the seed notice to 18 hours.

[Revisions — round 2, policy-task audit] T1-F1 / F-G4: evaluation_protocol selected constants (6 / 3 / 4 on every FCE referral) under a method label, leaving no honest method -> relabelled parameter; partial_attempt_credit became the computation's method (hour-for-hour within 7 days of the latest recorded evaluation day, half rounded down at 8-30 days, none when older — the results of an older attempt are retested in full); world unchanged at 1 hour credited, hours stay 5. O-G7: the job-matched tier no longer tests the job description (an FCE entry document every activated referral carries); it now tests modified duty more than 120 days after injury. O-G1: protocol sessions now have their own compute binding (protocol_sessions) and compute_basis line. O-G2: the inner rounding of the pro-rated reserved-time fee was removed, so the fee is rounded once at the end as the rule states. O-T1-1: the expiring authorization is now a one-day protocol at 1 session per week, so copying it no longer gives the requested 2 sessions. O-T1-2 (observation, no change): FCE suspension_max_days is 0 ("0 where suspension is not used"), so the base non-compliance suspension is not used on FCE referrals and the referral stays active; no extended policy reads status. Downstream: tracing (hours, sessions), computations, business effect, seed_consistency and edge_load_bearing regenerated; recomputed figures unchanged (5 / 150.00, skip -> 50.00).

[Manual value gates] User write: the authorization is genuinely the adjuster's act (he approved the reschedule and is the authorizer) and is completed on the spot. Simulator boundary: he never states hours, sessions or an amount; his passive line fires only on the agent's explanation. Chronology: every volunteered fact (missed 10-05 appointment, rebooked) is in the series rows. Authority: compensability, authorization and the miss come from system rows. No real-world wait. Draft recomputation from the visible context gives the authorization (5 h, 2 sessions) then the fee 150.00 for 2026-10-05.

[Difficulty closure] Task 0 claims 3 policies / 3 tools, task 1 claims 2 policies / 2 tools: union = all 5 extended policies, pairwise disjoint; both trees contain a user write (record_program_extension_8df51c57, record_fce_authorization_83d13911).

[Final difficulty run, no --task] EXTENDED OK (5 policies, 5 tools, 2 tasks, full coverage, disjoint scopes); TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK (0.json 12 actions, 1.json 10 actions, deterministic, non-vacuous, no Error); SOLVABILITY OK; COMPUTE OK (suite means, history and branch maxima above their floors; see the round-2 final run below); GROUNDING OK; CACHE-DIFF INFO (no cache trap used); SCOPE OK. check_traceability is left for after the KB is published.

[Final difficulty run, round 2, no --task] EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK (0.json 12 actions, 1.json 10 actions); SOLVABILITY OK; COMPUTE OK (suite means branches 37.00 >= 4, steps 11.00 >= 4; history_rows_max 52 >= 8; branches_max 49 >= 5); GROUNDING OK; CACHE-DIFF INFO (no cache trap used); SCOPE OK. check_traceability is left for after the KB is published.
user_scenario:
You are Curtis Wardlow, a senior claims adjuster with Tar River Casualty Company, calling Piedmont Motion's patient services line about your claimant Marisol Vance, claim TRC5408816, who is being seen for a Functional Capacity Evaluation at Piedmont Motion Hickory. You are dry, methodical and polite, and you like to close each item on your list before moving to the next.

Why you are calling: the Hickory scheduler left you a voicemail saying Marisol cancelled her functional capacity evaluation that was set for Monday, October 5, at the last minute, and that the evaluation has been rebooked. Your file note says Piedmont Motion bills the carrier a fee when an evaluation is missed, and you want that missed-evaluation fee put on Tar River's bill today so it goes through bill review together with the rest of her evaluation charges. You do not know what the fee should be and you do not suggest a figure; you ask the clinic to work it out and post it.

You give the claimant's name when you open. Only when the agent asks you to confirm her identity do you read from your claim file: her date of birth is 1984-11-02 and the ZIP code on the claim is 28601. You do not have her phone number, email or patient account number handy and say so if asked. If asked for the claim number, it is TRC5408816. You do not know her reason for cancelling or exactly when she called; if asked, tell the agent to go by the clinic's own records.

If the agent tells you the fee cannot be worked out or posted until an authorization covering the October 5 appointment is on the referral, you say: "That one is on me — I approved the rescheduled evaluation with your scheduler by phone last week and never put the authorization in. I'll record it myself right now, reference TRA5104458, covering October 5 through October 16. Just tell me how many evaluation hours and how many sessions you need on it." When the agent gives you the hours and the sessions and hands you the authorization to record, you record it yourself exactly as given, with your reference TRA5104458, the dates October 5 through October 16, and the referral reference number the agent reads out to you. If the agent asks you for anything else to be done first, you ask what the referral needs and do only what they tell you is needed.

Once the agent tells you the missed-evaluation fee has been posted to Tar River's bill, you say you'll watch for it in bill review, thank them, and end the call. You never mention the authorization before the agent raises it, never propose hours, sessions or an amount, and never ask for anything else.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.wc_case_id: Value bc5333cb-a599-41d5-9f4c-60f855d7b6a7. Basis: find_wc_cases returns the worker's only referral, the Functional Capacity Evaluation; the docstring says the agent reads it out. Unique: no other referral exists.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.hours: Value 5 (wc_ext_fce_authorization_hours): protocol 6 (off_work AND 219 days since the 2026-03-02 injury > 120: two-day protocol 4 + 4//2); order re-screen +1 (physician order 2026-06-24 is 105 days old: ninety-one to one hundred twenty); partial-attempt credit -1 (latest recorded evaluation day 2026-09-30 is 7 days before the request: the 1 hour already recorded is taken off hour for hour); core-only reduction -1 (one missed evaluation appointment, 2026-10-05, reported in the last month); 6+1-1-1 = 5.

Basis: the rule 'The requested evaluation sessions are two for a two-day protocol and one for any other protocol, and the authorization is recorded with them'. Unique: the protocol tier is the two-day one (off work, more than 120 days since injury); the expiring authorization's 1 session per week is not the requested figure.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.auth_end_date: Value 2026-10-16. Basis: same sentence. Unique: the adjuster's stated last date.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 150.00 (wc_ext_fce_missed_fee): reserved-time fee 500.00 (latest authorization TRA5104458 authorizes 5 hours > the 4-hour daily maximum: 250.00 x 2 sessions); notice share 0.5 (cancellation reached the clinic 18 hours before: twelve to twenty-three); reason share 0.8 (recorded reason transportation); first-miss courtesy 50.00 (the 2026-10-05 miss is the only one reported, rebooked 2026-10-05, 0 days after the miss); 500.00 x 0.5 x 0.8 - 50.00 = 150.00.

partial_attempt_credit (method): latest recorded evaluation day 2026-09-30, 7 days before the request -> the 1 recorded hour is taken off hour for hour; baseline nothing taken off -> result 6.

edges.condition: The referral's history holds an adjuster authorization whose first and last covered dates include the date of the missed evaluation appointment.
edges.policy_source: A missed-evaluation fee is not fixed until the referral carries an adjuster authorization whose dates cover the missed appointment.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The only authorization on the referral, TRA5097720, covers 2026-09-28..2026-10-02; the missed appointment is 2026-10-05, so no authorization covers it.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: One prerequisite only: authorization first, fee second. Posting the fee first reads TRA5097720 (4 hours, once) and gives 50.00 instead of 150.00, and violates the stated wait.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the authorization: no TRA5104458 row, wc_cases.auth_reference stays TRA5097720 (1 session per week) and authorized_visits_remaining 3 instead of 8, and the fee recomputes to 50.00 instead of 150.00.

prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: post_fce_missed_fee_9edc6261 posts the fee with whatever amount it receives and never looks for an authorization; record_fce_authorization_83d13911 records any reference, hours and dates without checking the referral's state. Neither returns an Error for an unmet prerequisite.
